# API Contracts Reference Manual

This document provides complete technical specifications for EX-aero's public APIs. It details C++ public interfaces, C/Fortran adapters, and exact index codes used to route outputs from physical and optical solvers.

---

## 1. C++ Public Interface (`IAerosolPackage.hpp`)

All aerosol packages (such as GOCART or MAM4xx) implement the abstract base class `exaero::IAerosolPackage`.

```cpp
namespace exaero {

    class IAerosolPackage {
    public:
        virtual ~IAerosolPackage() = default;

        // Dynamic Initialization
        virtual void initialize(const std::string& config_yaml) = 0;

        // Passive microphysics step (advances states like chemical mechanisms if applicable)
        virtual void executeMicrophysics(
            const EnvironmentalStateView& env,
            View3D<double>& state,
            double delta_time_sec) = 0;

        // Active Diagnostics Step (calculates wet/dry size, PM, ALW, etc.)
        virtual void computeDerivedDiagnostics(
            const EnvironmentalStateView& env,
            const View3D<const double>& state,
            View3D<double>& diagnostics_out) = 0;

        // Active Optical Properties Step (extinction, scattering, AOT across bands)
        virtual void computeOptics(
            const EnvironmentalStateView& env,
            const View3D<const double>& state,
            const View1D<const double>& wavelengths,
            View4D<double>& optics_out) = 0;

        // Active Cloud Microphysics CCN Activation Spectra over standard supersaturations
        virtual void computeCCN(
            const EnvironmentalStateView& env,
            const View3D<const double>& state,
            const View1D<const double>& supersaturations,
            View4D<double>& ccn_out) = 0;

        // Dynamic Species-to-Index mapping query APIs
        virtual int getSpeciesIndex(const std::string& name) const = 0;
        virtual std::string getSpeciesName(int index) const = 0;
    };

} // namespace exaero
```

---

## 2. C/Fortran ISO_C_BINDINGS Adapters

To integrate with atmospheric models written in Fortran (e.g., UFS physical cores), EX-aero exposes a C-linkage API (`IAerosolPackage_C.h`) which is mapped to Fortran via standard ISO_C_BINDINGS (`exaero_interface.f90`).

### A. Opaque Handle Pattern
Fortran maintains an opaque reference to the C++ instance using a C pointer wrapper:

```fortran
type, bind(c) :: exaero_package_t
  type(c_ptr) :: ptr = c_null_ptr
end type exaero_package_t
```

### B. Lifecycle Helpers
*   `exaero_create_gocart_package()`: Allocates and returns a GOCART package instance handle.
*   `exaero_free_package(pkg)`: Deallocates the package instance and avoids memory leaks.

### C. CCPP Standard Error Parameter Pattern
All execution wrappers enforce the Common Community Physics Package (CCPP) error signature:
*   `errmsg` (`char*` in C / `character(*)` in Fortran): Buffer containing error description if a fault occurs.
*   `errflg` (`int*` in C / `integer` in Fortran): Status code (`0` for success, non-zero for fatal failures).

---

## 3. Diagnostic & Optical Index Codes (`AerosolIndices.hpp`)

To write multidimensional outputs into shared arrays in a layout-agnostic way, solvers write outputs using fixed index codes.

### A. 3D Mass and Size Diagnostics (cell, level, index)
These index codes map 3-dimensional physical outputs computed during `computeDerivedDiagnostics`:

| Index Constant | Value | Description | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `MASS_CONCENTRATION` | `0` | 3D Mass Concentration per species | kg/m³ |
| `PM2_5_CONCENTRATION` | `1` | 3D PM2.5 Mass Concentration | kg/m³ |
| `PM10_CONCENTRATION` | `2` | 3D PM10 Mass Concentration | kg/m³ |
| `NUMBER_CONCENTRATION` | `3` | Derived lognormal particle concentration | particles/m³ |
| `SURFACE_AREA_DENSITY` | `4` | Total Surface Area Density (SAD) | m²/m³ |
| `AEROSOL_LIQUID_WATER` | `5` | Aerosol Liquid Water (ALW) mass absorbed | kg/m³ |
| `GRAVITATIONAL_SETTLING_VELOCITY` | `6` | Mass-weighted Stokes settling velocity | m/s |

### B. 2D Column-Integrated & Surface Mass Diagnostics (cell, level=0, index)
These index codes map column-integrated or surface-layer-specific 2D values:

| Index Constant | Value | Description | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `SURFACE_MASS` | `7` | Surface layer mass concentration | kg/m³ |
| `COLUMN_MASS` | `8` | Column-integrated total mass density | kg/m² |
| `SURFACE_PM2_5_MASS` | `9` | Surface layer PM2.5 mass concentration | kg/m³ |
| `COLUMN_PM2_5_MASS` | `10` | Column-integrated PM2.5 mass density | kg/m² |

### C. 3D Optical Properties (cell, level, index)
These index codes map multi-band optical outputs computed during `computeOptics`:

| Index Constant | Value | Description | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `EXTINCTION_COEFF` | `0` | 3D Extinction Coefficient | m⁻¹ |
| `SCATTERING_COEFF` | `1` | 3D Scattering Coefficient | m⁻¹ |
| `BACKSCATTER_COEFF` | `2` | 3D Backscatter Coefficient | m⁻¹ sr⁻¹ |
| `ASYMMETRY_FACTOR` | `3` | $g$ asymmetry parameter | fraction -1 to 1 |
| `LIDAR_BACKSCATTER` | `4` | 3D Lidar 180-deg Backscatter | m⁻¹ sr⁻¹ |

### D. 2D Column-Integrated Optical Diagnostics (cell, level=0, index)
These index codes map column-integrated optical thicknesses:

| Index Constant | Value | Description | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `EXTINCTION_AOT` | `5` | Total Extinction Aerosol Optical Thickness | dimensionless |
| `SCATTERING_AOT` | `6` | Total Scattering Aerosol Optical Thickness | dimensionless |
| `FINE_MODE_EXTINCTION_AOT` | `7` | Fine mode (sub-micron) extinction AOT | dimensionless |
| `FINE_MODE_SCATTERING_AOT` | `8` | Fine mode (sub-micron) scattering AOT | dimensionless |
| `PM2_5_EXTINCTION_AOT` | `9` | PM2.5 extinction AOT | dimensionless |
| `PM2_5_SCATTERING_AOT` | `10` | PM2.5 scattering AOT | dimensionless |
